tools.name: fetch_portfolio
tools.description: Fetches sample, sandbox, or live portfolio holdings for the authenticated user.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

tools.name: fetch_market_data
tools.description: Fetches real-time stock prices, 1-day change, volumes, benchmarks (^NSEI, ^INDIAVIX), and closing history.

tools.name: fetch_news
tools.description: Fetches recent market news, corporate announcements, and regulatory signals for symbols.

symbols.description: List of stock symbols to retrieve news for.

tools.name: run_analytics
tools.description: Computes deterministic financial analytics: HHI concentration, sector drift, drawdown/volatility, benchmark beta/alpha, and attribution.

market_data.description: Dictionary of symbol market quotes and closing histories.

tools.name: score_risk
tools.description: Evaluates risk thresholds (HHI > 0.25, drawdown > 15%, volatility > 25%, beta tilt) and returns composite risk score and alert triggers.

analytics_metrics.description: Pre-computed deterministic analytics payload from run_analytics.
